note: Steps written by hand from the footage (215 s phone video of a pink-and-white folding clothes drying rack outdoors: folded walkaround, joint and wing close-ups, unfolding, rail spreading, final open check). The audio track is quiet handling sound and was not transcribed, so there is no transcript; timestamps come from observed actions. Positions come from hand-observed box centres and are placeholders until a 3D model is captured and calibrated.

steps.instruction: Look over the folded rack standing on its feet.
Check the wings with hanger holes, the pink joints and the feet.
Pull the folded wings apart until they swing open.
Spread the rails out level on both sides.
Walk around the open rack and check the joints sit locked.

title: Clothes drying rack set-up
